newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela electric firms see 50 pct rate hike soon.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela electric firms see 50 pct rate hike soon.

text.p: Venezuela's Electricity Industry Chamber (Caveinel) said Wednesday it was confident the government would shortly approve a 40 to 50 percent increase in electricity tariffs.
"The average tariff shortfall for the sector is between 40 and 50 percent," Caveinel vice President Carlos Perez Mibelli told Reuters.
Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Tuesday rates would be adjusted shortly.
"The minister told us there would be an adjustment in January and there wasn't. We hope that what he said yesterday happens," Perez said.

Officials at the Electricity Regulatory Commission (CREE) which studies rate rises said recently that the latest tariff adjustments were ready and only required the go-ahead of Arrieta and President Rafael Caldera.
"We hope and trust the adjustment will be made as soon as possible. We've been waiting five and a half months," Perez said. "The more it is delayed the more it damages the companies and users."
